title: EnginePort — Abstract Backend Transport in Angular
content: Define an EnginePort as InjectionToken<EnginePort> interface. Production uses HttpEngineService (fetch), tests use MockEngineService (canned typed responses). Consumers inject ENGINE_PORT. Gives component-testability, transport-swappability, typed returns (no any). Takes ~1 day. Full reference: @wiki/patterns/engine-port-backend-abstraction
